logp.method_description: Oil/water partition coefficients (log PO/W) were determined at room temperature following a reported method. 64 The examined complexes (10 μM) dissolved in 1 mL water, and 1 mL n–octanol was added. The mixture was sonicated for 30 min, separated by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 10 min. The concentrations of complex in two phases were measured by UV–Vis. Each measurement was repeated for 3 times.
